csv_scope_of_work: The Virginia department of transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide a Planning/Design for Warwick Blvd and Colony Dr Intersection Improvements. Funding supports improvements to include the extension of the Warwick Boulevard southbound left turn lane; adding a second northbound left turn lane to reduce congestion reconstruction of the corners to accommodate school buses new pedestrian refuge areas being constructed on both legs of Warwick Boulevard new Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) compliant ramps, pulling the sidewalk corner in to accommodate for current standards of crosswalks and ADA ramps and relocating four (4) existing double pedestrian signals.
